audit_method: Each claim evaluated against actual evidence corpus. Citation ID existence does NOT guarantee support. Support evaluated on: (a) citation resolves in citations.json, (b) cited page OCR/evidence excerpt content, (c) claim wording matches what evidence shows.

support_categories.SUPPORTED: Citation resolves AND page content / observation excerpt supports the claim wording.
support_categories.PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: Citation resolves but only partial wording supported; requires narrowing.
support_categories.NOT_SUPPORTED: Citation absent OR page content contradicts / cannot back the factual assertion.
support_categories.METADATA_ONLY: Not a citation-requiring historical claim (status, methodology, reflection).
